function.name: list_files
function.description: List the files in the environment.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send a message to the other agent. This ends your turn.

function.name: end_session
function.description: End the entire session. The other agent will NOT be activated, will NOT see this, and will NOT reply; nothing further happens. Use this ONLY when you are completely finished. Do NOT use it to pause, wait for a reply, or pass the turn: to continue or wait for the other agent, send a message instead.

note.description: Optional closing note (private; not sent to the other agent).

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write contents to a file, creating it if it does not exist or overwriting it if it does.
